name: 47305 · Muncie, IN
findings: ZIP 47305 (Muncie) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47305 (Muncie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
92% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47305 (Muncie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 13.3 times the typical level).
